info.title: Himring API for signed-in accounts
info.description: Every operation of the Himring API that only a signed-in account can call, such as the operations that manage projects, members, and API keys.

post.summary: Replace every record of a live index with a .nrsl snapshot of at most 1 GiB, sent as the raw request body, such as a file that download_index produced. Himring loads the snapshot into a separate copy first, and refuses it when its fields differ from the schema of the index, or when its vectors differ from the vectors that the embedding model of the index makes for the same text, which it checks on up to 8 records. The copy then takes the language, stop words, synonyms, and BM25 settings of the index, and replaces the index in one step, so that searches read the old records until the new ones serve. One restore of an index runs at a time, and only a project owner can send one.

post.summary: Finish a sign-in that start_source_sign_in began, with the state and the code that the platform added to the address of the dashboard. Each state works once, for 10 minutes, and only for a member of the project of the source.
post.description:
Finish a sign-in that start_source_sign_in began, with the state and the code that the platform added to the address of the dashboard. Each state works once, for 10 minutes, and only for a member of the project of the source.

A signed-in account whose second factor is set up and whose sign-up an operator approved may call this operation.

x-himring-rules.message: Send the code exactly as the platform returned it to the dashboard.

knowledge_base_id.description: The knowledge base that the source feeds, or null for a source of the Memory.

memory_id.description: The Memory that the source feeds, or null for a source of a knowledge base.

sorting.description: For a source of the Memory, full when Himring sorts each message through every step, rules_only when it sorts by rules alone, and as_given when it stores each message as given after checks for duplicates and conflicts. null for a source of a knowledge base.

status.description: active while Himring follows the source, failing while the last sync or fetch failed, and deleting while Himring removes what the source brought.

credential_names.description: The names of the credentials that Himring holds for the source. No answer shows their values.

webhook_url.description: Where the platform sends its webhooks, or null for a source that sends none.

sign_in.description: waiting until someone finishes a sign-in, signed_in while Himring reads through it, and expired once the platform refuses to refresh it, with the workspace, site, or user that it reads as. null for a source that reads with keys.

code.description: What went wrong, such as source_credentials_refused or source_unreachable.

api_key.description: An API key of one project, sent as Authorization: Bearer followed by the key. A key reaches its own project alone, and its permissions decide which operations it may call.

session_token.description: The session token that sign_in, verify_second_factor, or confirm_second_factor_setup returns to an account, sent as Authorization: Bearer followed by the token.

error_code.description: The code of the refusal. The API sends one of the listed codes, each with the HTTP status and the message under x-himring-error-codes, and the HTTP server can send another lowercase code for a request that it refuses before Himring reads it.

validation_failed.message: The API refused some fields of the request. Correct the fields listed under issues, then send it again.

invalid_json.message: The request body is not valid JSON. Send a JSON object.

invalid_path_parameter.message: A part of the path is not valid percent-encoding. Encode the IDs in the path correctly.

payload_too_large.message: The request body is larger than this operation accepts. Send a smaller body.

unsupported_media_type.message: The request body is not uncompressed JSON. Send it with the content type application/json.

not_found.message: The API has no route for this path. Read GET /v1/operations for the routes.

method_not_allowed.message: The path does not take this method. Read GET /v1/operations for the method of each route.

rate_limited.message: Too many requests came from this client. Wait for the seconds in Retry-After, then try again.

handler_timeout.message: The API took too long to answer. Try the request again.

internal_error.message: The API failed to handle the request. Try again, and report the problem if it keeps failing.

credential_required.message: This operation needs a credential. Send an API key or a session token as a bearer token.

credential_invalid.message: The credential is unknown, expired, or revoked. Sign in again, or create a new API key.

api_key_expired.message: The API key passed its expiry date. Create a new API key in Himring, or ask a member of the project for one.

session_required.message: This operation needs a signed-in engineer, not an API key. Sign in and send the session token.

second_factor_setup_required.message: Set up your second factor before you use Himring. Begin the setup, then confirm it with a code.

account_pending_approval.message: Your account is waiting for approval. Himring lets you in once an operator approves it.

account_rejected.message: An operator rejected your account. Contact Himring if you think that this is a mistake.

not_an_operator.message: Only a Himring operator can do this. Ask an operator to do it.

sign_in_failed.message: The email address or the password is wrong. Check both and try again.

password_wrong.message: The password is wrong. Send the password of your account.

account_locked.message: Too many sign-ins failed for this account. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.

challenge_invalid.message: The sign-in challenge is unknown or expired. Sign in with your password again.

second_factor_invalid.message: The code is wrong or expired. Send the code that your authenticator app shows now.

second_factor_already_enabled.message: Your second factor is already set up. Sign in with it.

second_factor_setup_not_started.message: No second-factor setup is waiting for a code. Begin the setup first.

account_not_found.message: No account has this ID. Check the ID in the list of accounts.

account_already_decided.message: An operator has already decided this account the other way, and Himring keeps that first decision. Leave the account as it is; an engineer whom an operator rejected can sign up again with another email address.

project_not_found.message: No project that you can reach has this ID. Check the ID in your list of projects.

project_deleted.message: The project is deleted. Restore the project first.

not_a_project_owner.message: Only an owner of the project can do this. Ask an owner to do it.

no_cell_accepts_projects.message: No region of Himring accepts new projects now. Ask a Himring operator to open a region for them.

last_owner.message: The project needs at least one owner. Invite another owner before the last one leaves.

member_not_found.message: This account is not a member of the project. Check the account ID.

already_a_member.message: This person is already a member of the project. Open the project from their list of projects.

invitation_not_found.message: Himring has no invitation with this token or ID. Check it, or ask an owner of the project for a new one.

invitation_already_open.message: An open invitation already exists for this email address. Revoke it before you invite again.

invitation_closed.message: The invitation was already accepted or revoked. Ask an owner of the project for a new one.

invitation_expired.message: The invitation has expired. Ask an owner of the project for a new one.

invitation_email_failed.message: Himring could not send the invitation email, so it kept no invitation. Send the invitation again after one minute.

invitation_for_another_email.message: The invitation is for another email address. Sign in with the address that the owner invited.

api_key_not_found.message: No API key of this project has this ID. Check the ID.

api_key_permission_missing.message: The permissions of this API key leave out what this request needs. The missing permission is in missing_permission. Ask a member of the project to give the key that permission, or use another key.

database_not_found.message: No database of this project has this ID. Check the ID in the list of databases.

database_name_taken.message: Another database of this project has this name. Choose another name.

database_deleted.message: The database is deleted. Restore it first.

database_migration_refused.message: Himring refuses a statement in the migration. Remove the statement quoted in the details, then send it again.

database_migration_failed.message: SQLite failed to apply the migration. Its error is in details. Correct the SQL, then send it again.

database_migration_conflict.message: Someone added another migration to the database first. List the migrations, then send yours again.

database_migration_pending.message: Himring is still applying an earlier migration to this database. Send yours again after 10 seconds.

index_not_found.message: No index of this project has this ID. Check the ID in the list of indexes.

index_name_taken.message: Another index of this project has this name. Choose another name.

index_deleted.message: The index is deleted. Restore it first.

index_config_invalid.message: The search server refused the index config. Its reason is in details. Correct the config, then send it again.

knowledge_base_not_found.message: No knowledge base of this project has this ID. Check the ID in the list of knowledge bases.

knowledge_base_name_taken.message: Another knowledge base of this project has this name. Choose another name.

knowledge_base_deleted.message: The knowledge base is deleted. Restore it first.

knowledge_base_not_ready.message: Himring is still creating this knowledge base. Try again after 10 seconds.

file_not_found.message: No file of this knowledge base has this ID. Check the ID in the list of files.

file_deleted.message: The file is deleted. Restore it first, or send it again under its path.

file_path_taken.message: A live file of this knowledge base now has this path. Delete that file before you restore this one.

file_too_large.message: The file is larger than Himring accepts. Split the file, or send a smaller one.

file_empty.message: The file has no content. Send a file with content.

file_version_not_found.message: The file has no version with this number. Check the versions on the page of the file.

file_rendition_missing.message: Himring keeps a PDF only of a Word file or a slide deck that it has read. Download the original of this version instead.

storage_unavailable.message: Himring could not reach the store that keeps original files. Try again after 10 seconds.

embedding_unavailable.message: The embedding service did not turn the question into a vector. Try again after 10 seconds.

usage_log_unavailable.message: Himring could not record the search for billing, so it held back the answer. Try again after 2 seconds.

search_timed_out.message: The search took longer than its time limit, so Himring stopped it. Try again after 2 seconds.

search_filters_rebuilding.message: Himring is rebuilding the search index of this knowledge base so that searches can filter by folder and metadata. Search without the filter, or try again once the rebuild finishes.

saved_question_not_found.message: No saved question of this knowledge base has this ID. Check the ID in the list of saved questions.

question_already_saved.message: The knowledge base already holds a saved question with this text. Update that question instead.

question_set_full.message: The knowledge base holds as many saved questions as Himring keeps. Delete some before you save more.

question_set_empty.message: The knowledge base holds no saved question to score. Save a question with the passage that answers it.

passage_not_found.message: Himring found no passage at that place in a current version of a live file. Give a chunk that search returned, or a block range of the current version.

passage_choice_invalid.message: Give one passage, either by chunk_id or by file_id with first_position and last_position. To keep the passage that a saved question already holds, send confirm with no passage.

question_file_invalid.message: Himring could not read the file of questions. The place where reading failed is in details. Correct it, then send it again.

scorecard_not_found.message: No scorecard of this knowledge base has this ID. Check the ID in the list of scorecards.

correction_not_found.message: No correction of this knowledge base has this ID. Check the ID in the list of corrections.

correction_pass_not_found.message: No correction pass of this knowledge base has this ID. Check the ID in the list of passes.

correction_decided.message: Someone already promoted or discarded this correction. Propose a new correction to change the setting.

correction_not_tried.message: Himring promotes a correction only after it has tried it. Try the correction first.

correction_lowers_held_back.message: The correction broke held-back questions or moved their passages further from first, so Himring refuses to promote it. Discard it.

no_held_back_questions.message: Himring checks a correction on held-back questions, and none passed through it. Save more questions first.

correction_kinds_clash.message: A pass builds at most two second indexes, so send at most two corrections that change the index, each of a different kind. Try the others in a later pass.

correction_pass_running.message: A correction pass is under way on this knowledge base. Wait until it finishes, then try again.

correction_passes_exhausted.message: The project has used every correction pass that it gets today. Try again after midnight UTC.

correction_settings_moved.message: The search settings changed after Himring tried this correction, so its score no longer holds. Try the correction again.

flagged_question_not_found.message: No flagged question of this knowledge base has this ID. Check the ID in the list of flagged questions.

flagged_question_saved.message: This flagged question is already a saved question. Update the saved question to change its passage.

answer_log_invalid.message: Himring could not read the log of answers. The place where reading failed is in details. Correct it, then send it again.

passage_already_confirmed.message: The passage of this saved question waits for no confirmation. Give a new passage to change it.

api_key_already_revoked.message: The API key is already revoked. Create a new API key if you need one.

account_identity_fixed.message: An account keeps the ID and the email address that it signed up with. Sign up again for another address.

record_fixed.message: Himring keeps this part of the record as it was first written. Create a new record.

migration_fixed.message: Himring keeps a migration as it was written once the database has it. Add a new migration.

cell_mismatch.message: The record is in another region from its project. Create it again inside the project.

purge_not_due.message: The record is still recoverable, so Himring keeps it. Wait until its purge time passes.

erasure_unfinished.message: Himring could not reach every knowledge base of the project, so the erasure is unfinished. Send the same request again after 10 seconds to finish it.

cell_unavailable.message: The database server or the search server of this region did not answer. Try again after 10 seconds.

control_database_unavailable.message: The API could not reach its control database. Try again after 10 seconds.

index_record_not_found.message: No record of this index has this ID. Check the ID in the list of records.

index_record_invalid.message: The search server refused the record. Its reason is in details. Correct the record, then send it again.

index_filters_invalid.message: The search server refused the filters or the search. Its reason is in details. Filter only on the fields of the schema, with tests that their types take.

index_cursor_invalid.message: The cursor belongs to another search or other filters. Start again from the first page.

index_records_file_invalid.message: Himring could not read the file of records. The reason is in details. Correct it, then send it again.

index_settings_invalid.message: The search server refused the settings. Its reason is in details. Correct them, then send them again.

index_synonym_stop_word.message: A synonym rule uses a stop word, which search leaves out of every record and every query, so the rule can never match. The rule and the word are in each issue. Take the word out of the rule, or out of the stop words.

index_settings_changed.message: Another settings change is pending or has changed this index. Read the index, then send your change again.

index_embedding_model_unknown.message: This index records no embedding model that Himring offers, so it can search by keyword alone. Search it in keyword mode.

index_settings_pending.message: The search server is applying the settings, and the saved change will continue after this request. Read the index before retrying the change.

index_restore_running.message: Another restore of this index is in progress. Wait until it finishes, then send the snapshot again.

index_snapshot_invalid.message: The search server could not read the snapshot. Its reason is in details. Send a snapshot that you downloaded from a Himring index.

index_snapshot_schema_mismatch.message: The fields of the snapshot differ from the schema of this index. The difference is in details. Restore the snapshot into an index with the same schema.

index_snapshot_model_mismatch.message: The vectors in the snapshot differ from the vectors that the embedding model of this index makes for the same text, so a search by meaning would return the wrong records. Restore a snapshot that the same model embedded.

source_not_found.message: No source of this knowledge base has this ID. Check the ID with list_sources.

source_limit_reached.message: The knowledge base holds as many sources as it can. Delete a source that you no longer need first.

source_settings_invalid.message: The settings or the credentials do not fit this kind of source. Correct the fields listed under issues.

source_credentials_refused.message: The platform refused the credentials, or they cannot read the bucket, the account, or the prefix in the settings. Check them with the platform, then send them again.

source_credentials_unreadable.message: Himring cannot open the stored credentials of this source, so it keeps them unchanged. Send every credential of the source again under credentials.

source_unreachable.message: Himring could not reach the platform to check the credentials. Try again after 30 seconds.

source_endpoint_refused.message: Himring reads buckets only at public addresses. Send the public https endpoint of the bucket, or leave it out for Amazon S3.

source_not_pushable.message: Himring feeds this source from its platform, so it takes no items from your code. Send them to a push source.

source_not_syncable.message: A push source takes what your code sends and has nothing to sync.

source_has_no_webhook_secret.message: Himring makes webhook secrets only for Vapi sources. Replace the secret of other sources through credentials.

source_changed.message: Another change to this source arrived at the same moment. Read the source, then send your change again.

source_deleting.message: Himring is removing this source. Create a new source if you need one.

source_sign_in_not_used.message: This source reads with the keys under its credentials, so it has no sign-in to start.

source_platform_not_configured.message: The operator of this Himring has not registered an app with this platform, so nobody can sign in to it yet.

source_sign_in_invalid.message: The sign-in has expired, was used already, or belongs to a project that your account cannot use. Start it again with start_source_sign_in.

source_sign_in_refused.message: The platform refused to finish the sign-in, or the account that signed in cannot read what the source needs. Start the sign-in again and approve every permission that the platform asks for.

source_workspace_in_another_project.message: A source in another project reads this Slack workspace already, and one workspace feeds one project only. Sign in to another workspace, or add the source to the project that reads this one.

file_path_reserved.message: Himring keeps the folder sources/ for the files that sources write. Send the file under another folder, or send it to a push source with ingest_items.

webhook_signature_invalid.message: The signature of the webhook is missing or does not match the secret of this source.

webhook_timestamp_invalid.message: The timestamp of the webhook is missing or too far from the time now, so Himring treats it as a replay.

webhook_too_large.message: The webhook is larger than Himring accepts. Turn off the audio in the webhook of the platform.

webhook_not_understood.message: The webhook carries no ID of a call, a conversation, or a ticket that Himring can read.

memory_not_found.message: This project has no Memory with this ID. Read the ID of the Memory with get_memory.

memory_not_enabled.message: This project has no Memory in that state. Turn Memory on with enable_memory.

memory_already_enabled.message: This project has a live Memory already, and a project holds one. Read it with get_memory.

memory_deleted.message: The Memory is deleted. Restore it first.

memory_not_ready.message: Himring is still creating this Memory. Try again after 10 seconds.

stored_memory_not_found.message: The Memory holds no memory with this ID. Check the ID with list_memories.

memory_message_not_found.message: This source of the Memory has no message with this external ID and version. Check both with list_messages.

memory_review_not_found.message: The Memory has no review with this ID. Check the ID with list_memory_reviews.

memory_review_settled.message: Someone has settled this review already. Read the memory with inspect_memory to see the outcome.

memory_replaced.message: A newer memory replaced this one. Read replaced_by with inspect_memory and act on that memory.

memory_not_personal.message: This memory came from a source that is not private, so it already has the scope that its source gave.

memory_forgotten.message: Someone forgot this memory. Bring it back with recover_memory before you change it.

memory_not_forgotten.message: Nobody forgot this memory, so there is nothing to recover. Read it with inspect_memory.

memory_decision_not_found.message: The Memory has no decision with this ID. Check the ID with list_memory_decisions.

memory_webhook_not_set.message: The Memory sends its decisions to no webhook. Set one with set_memory_webhook.

memory_webhook_url_refused.message: Himring sends webhooks to public https addresses alone, and this URL leads to a private, local, or reserved one, or uses http. Send the public https URL of your endpoint.

learned_change_not_found.message: The Memory has no learned change with this ID. Check the ID with list_learned_changes.

learned_change_undone.message: Someone has undone this learned change already. Read the settings with get_memory.

memory_tuning_has_no_new_input.message: A tuning run would use nothing new, since no labelled decision, saved question, or memory changed since the last run. Read tuning in get_memory_scores to see when Himring tunes again by itself.

memory_saved_question_not_found.message: The Memory has no saved question with this ID. Check the ID with list_memory_saved_questions.

memory_saved_questions_over_limit.message: A Memory keeps at most 2,000 saved questions. Delete one with delete_memory_saved_question first.

recall_reader_missing.message: Send end_user_id or team_id, since the context belongs to one end user or team.

recall_date_in_future.message: Send as_of as a time in the past, or leave it out for the current memories.

memory_scope_invalid.message: Send team_id with the scope team, and leave owner_id out for the scope company.

memory_owner_scope_missing.message: Send owner_id with one scope, end_user or team, and without end_user_id or team_id.

memory_export_record_too_large.message: One memory and its sources exceed the 32 MiB export limit. Read that memory with inspect_memory and continue the export after its ID.

source_kind_memory_only.message: An agent source feeds the Memory alone. Connect it with create_memory_source, or send your agents' calls to a push source of the knowledge base.

source_kind_knowledge_base_only.message: This connector holds documents, so connect it with create_source to a knowledge base that this Memory checks. The Memory checks its memories against that knowledge base while it sorts.

checked_knowledge_bases_over_limit.message: A Memory checks at most 10 knowledge bases while it sorts. Shorten checked_knowledge_base_ids to the ones whose files matter most.

knowledge_base_in_another_cell.message: This knowledge base is in another region from the Memory, so the Memory cannot check it. Remove its ID, which is in details, from checked_knowledge_base_ids.

sorting_not_offered.message: Sorting applies to sources of the Memory alone. Leave sorting out for a source of a knowledge base.

source_table_unreadable.message: Himring cannot read the table, or the table lacks the ID column or another column in the settings. Check the names against the migrations of the database.

sorting_unavailable.message: Himring could not sort the message, because a part of sorting did not answer. Try again after 10 seconds.

database_access_denied.message: Your role in the project does not allow this kind of database work. The access that the work needs is in details. Ask an owner of the project.

table_not_found.message: The database has no table or view with this name. Read the names with list_database_tables.

column_not_found.message: The table has no column with a name that the request gives. The missing name is in details. Read the columns with list_database_tables.

table_read_only.message: Himring edits rows only in a table with a primary key or a rowid, so this view or table takes no edits here. Change it with SQL in run_database_sql.

table_row_not_found.message: The table has no row with this key. Read the keys again with list_table_rows.

table_row_changed.message: Someone changed or deleted this row after you read it, so Himring left it alone. Read the row again with get_table_row, then make your change on what it holds now.

table_row_invalid.message: SQLite refused the row. Its reason, such as a broken NOT NULL, UNIQUE, CHECK, or foreign key rule, is in details. Correct the values and send them again.

database_sql_refused.message: Himring refuses a statement that reaches outside the database, changes its settings, or touches the tables that Sirannon keeps. The refused statement and the reason are in details. Change the statement, then send it again.

database_sql_failed.message: SQLite could not run a statement. Its error is in details. Correct the statement and run it again.

database_schema_change_needs_migration.message: The SQL changes the schema, and Himring changes a schema only through a migration, so that every copy of the database applies the same change. Add it with add_database_migration, or ask propose_database_change to write one.

database_query_timed_out.message: The query read for longer than the workspace allows, so Himring stopped it. Narrow it with a WHERE clause or an index, or read fewer rows.

database_result_too_large.message: The rows of the query come to more than the workspace sends at once. Read fewer rows or fewer columns.

database_change_too_large.message: The SQL changes more rows, or takes longer to try, than the workspace applies at once. The numbers are in details. Split it into smaller changes, or apply it as a migration.

database_confirmation_invalid.message: The confirmation token expired or was used, or the SQL, schema, or number of changed rows differs from the preview. Run the SQL again without a token for a new count and confirmation.

database_workspace_busy.message: The database is answering as many workspace queries as it allows at once. Try again after 1 second.

database_writes_busy.message: Other writes to the database kept running while Himring waited to pause them for a write preview or an import check. Try again after 10 seconds.

saved_query_not_found.message: The database has no saved query with this ID. Read the IDs with list_saved_queries.

saved_queries_full.message: A database keeps at most 200 saved queries. Delete one with delete_saved_query first.

database_changed_since_proposal.message: Another migration reached the database after the proposal read its schema, so Himring left the database alone. Ask propose_database_change again.

database_assistant_unavailable.message: The assistant that writes migrations did not answer, and Himring charged nothing. Try again after 10 seconds.

database_assistant_declined.message: The assistant could not write a migration that passes the checks of Himring for this request. The reason is in details. Rephrase the request, or write the migration yourself.

table_columns_fixed.message: Himring changes the columns of an ordinary table, and this is a view or a virtual table. Change it with a migration in add_database_migration.

column_change_invalid.message: The changes contradict each other or the table, such as two changes to one column. The contradiction is in details. Correct the changes and send them again.

column_name_taken.message: Another column of the table already has the name, and SQLite compares column names without regard to letter case. Choose another name.

column_change_refused.message: The change would lose data or break an index, view, trigger, constraint, or key that uses the column. That object is in details. Change or remove that object first, or write the migration yourself.

table_too_large_to_rebuild.message: The change copies the table into a new one, and Himring copies at most 100000 rows this way. Rename, add at the end, and drop are available on this table.

column_change_rows_fail.message: Some rows hold values that the changed column refuses, such as NULL in a column that becomes NOT NULL. The count of those rows is in details. Correct those rows, then make the change again.

database_schema_changed.message: Another migration reached the database after you read its columns, so Himring left it alone. Read the table again with list_database_tables, then make the change on what it holds now.

table_definition_invalid.message: The columns of the new table contradict each other or the database, such as two columns with one name or a foreign key to a column that is neither a primary key nor unique. The contradiction is in details. Correct the columns and send them again.

table_name_taken.message: A table, view, index, or trigger of the database already has the name, and SQLite compares names without regard to letter case. Choose another name.

table_name_reserved.message: Names that start with sqlite_, _sirannon, or _himring belong to SQLite, Sirannon, and Himring. Choose a name that starts another way.

table_export_value_too_large.message: A value in the rows to export is longer than the 1,048,576 characters, or the 524,288 bytes of a blob, that one export carries. Filter that row out, or read it with SQL in parts with substr.

table_import_file_invalid.message: Himring could not read the file as CSV or as an XLSX workbook, or the workbook holds formulas, macros, or links to other files. The reason is in details. Save the sheet as values only, or as CSV, and upload it again.

table_import_too_large.message: An import holds at most 1000000 rows and 200 columns. The limit that the file passes is in details. Split the file and import each part.

table_import_database_full.message: The database, its pending imports, and room for two copies of the file would pass the size limit of the database. The sizes are in details. Delete rows or discard a pending import first.

table_import_not_found.message: The import does not exist, or its 24 hours passed and Himring dropped its rows. Upload the file again.

table_import_pending.message: Another import into this table waits to be applied or discarded. Apply or discard it, or wait 24 hours for Himring to drop it.

table_import_not_checked.message: Check the import with check_table_import after its columns are set, then apply it.

table_import_changed.message: The table, the column mapping, or the failing rows changed after the check. The change is in details. Check the import again, then apply it.

table_import_check_failed.message: Himring could not try the rows against the table, for example because a mapped column is missing or generated. The reason is in details. Change the columns and check again.

table_import_too_many_failures.message: More than 10,000 rows of the file fail, so the import cannot be applied. Correct the file and upload it again.

database_size_limit_reached.message: The database has reached its size limit, so Himring refuses every write that needs more space. The limit is in details. Reads, deletes, and DROP TABLE work as usual. DROP TABLE and a delete that empties whole pages free space at once, while compact_database returns the free space that deletes leave inside partly filled pages, so delete what you no longer need, compact the database, and send the write again.

database_compaction_too_soon.message: A compaction of this database is running or started less than an hour ago, and Himring runs one compaction for each database in an hour. Read the compaction field of the database to see when the last one started, and send the request again an hour after that.

database_compaction_disk_short.message: The disk of the database server lacks the free space that a compaction needs, which is twice the size of the database file, so Himring did not start it. Report the code to Himring, because only Himring can free space on that disk.

database_server_disk_full.message: The disk of the database server is full, so the server refused the write. Send the write again after one minute, and report the code to Himring if it repeats.

upload_not_found.message: No upload of this knowledge base has this ID. Start the upload again with create_upload.

upload_closed.message: The upload is complete or failed, so it takes no more parts. Read it with get_upload.

upload_expired.message: The upload passed its deadline before every byte arrived. Start a new upload with create_upload.

upload_incomplete.message: Storage holds only some of the bytes of the upload. The missing parts are in details. Send those parts, then complete the upload again.

upload_part_out_of_range.message: The upload has fewer parts than this part number. Number the parts from 1 up to part_count.

upload_part_mismatch.message: The SHA-256 of a single upload belongs to the whole file. Sign part 1 with the content_sha256 of the upload.

upload_size_mismatch.message: Storage received a different number of bytes from the size of the upload, so Himring deleted them. Start a new upload with the size of the file.

upload_checksum_mismatch.message: The bytes in storage do not match the SHA-256 of the upload, so Himring deleted them. Hash the file again, then start a new upload.

upload_cancelled.message: The upload was cancelled. Start a new upload with create_upload.

uploads_busy.message: This project has as many uploads open as Himring allows. The limit is in details. Complete or cancel an upload, or try again after 30 seconds.

storage_events_not_expected.message: This API takes no events from storage. Set STORAGE_EVENTS_SECRET to turn them on.

storage_event_signature_invalid.message: The signature of the storage event is missing or does not match the storage events secret. Sign the event with the secret in STORAGE_EVENTS_SECRET.

storage_event_timestamp_invalid.message: The timestamp of the storage event is missing or more than five minutes from the time now. Send the event with the time of sending in webhook-timestamp.

storage_event_too_large.message: The storage event is larger than Himring accepts. Send at most 100 records in each event.

storage_event_not_understood.message: The storage event holds no records of a created object that Himring can read. Send the object-created records of the bucket in the S3 event format.

error.description: The API refused the request or failed to handle it. The code under error.code names the reason, and the status matches that code.

request_id.description: The ID of the request, which Himring support can find in its logs.

retry_after.description: The whole seconds to wait before you send the request again. The API sends it with every 503 refusal and with the 429 refusals rate_limited, database_workspace_busy, and uploads_busy.
